label: Python.org Job Board
terms_note: Community board; each post gives a contact e-mail/URL — a person applies.

endpoints.call: keep — human for apply (each posting names the employer's contact / e-mail); the RSS (application/rss+xml) is a usable public feed
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: Curated Python jobs. PSF community job board with a public RSS feed; no API. robots.txt blocks HTTrack, Nutch, Krugle, MSIECrawler with Disallow: / for unlisted agents; no terms page for the board.

search.note: Python.org Job Board RSS 2.0 feed (latest 20 approved jobs). query is not sent (the feed documents no search parameter) - filter the returned postings client-side; the feed answers its whole current list in one response, so ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). Items carry no pubDate (posted_at is null); description begins with the location line followed by the HTML job description. title is '<Role>, <Company>'. id is the job page link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
